correctness.rationale: For integers a,b>=3, parallel outdegree-one chip firing sends the two holes one step around disjoint cycles, giving exact period lcm(a,b). CRT identifies their simultaneous omission pairs with i≡j mod d=gcd(a,b), hence the disjoint union of d complete bipartite graphs K_{a/d,b/d}. Firing facets are complements of these edges, i.e. Y(H)=Ind(H)^*. The claimed false-twin suspension lemma follows because link(new vertex) is Y(J) and deletion is a cone based at its twin; cofibration pushout yields a suspension. For d>=2 the base matching dual has d facets whose nerve is boundary of (d-1)-simplex; d=1 explicitly starts with a void geometric realization and first duplication yields S^0. Exactly a+b-2d duplications give S^(a+b-d-2). All stated boundary cases a,b>=3 are handled; finite simulation is corroborative, not proof of the infinite assertion.
residual_risks: The exact avalanche convention is tied to simultaneous firing and one hole per cycle; different conventions can alter the claim.
